units.source_text: 这篇报道就是那帮家伙送报纸来的目的。

en.t: This article was the very reason those people had brought the newspaper.

units.source_text: 他们怎么可能会来满足我的请求呢。

en.t: How could they possibly have come to grant my request?

units.source_text: 他们就差没往那消息周围打上红框了，也算是万幸。

en.t: It was a mercy, at least, that they had not gone so far as to draw a red frame around that notice.

units.source_text: 这么说来，真有那帮叫做“黑杰克”的，专爱起哄的家伙吧……

en.t: Come to think of it, there really must be people like those Black Jacks, the kind who love stirring up trouble...

units.source_text: 皮袋子里灌满了沙，具有和铁棒、铅棒相匹敌的打击力……

en.t: A leather bag filled with sand has striking power to rival an iron bar or a lead club...
Even though sand, too, can flow...

units.source_text: 但水里可以游泳，而沙子却幽闭人，杀戮人……

en.t: But in water one can swim, while sand shuts people in and kills them...
